## Acceptance criteria — both reviewers cover all

1. Aimed E/Q, prompt and cue share one pure reachable visible host. Ahead/behind/inside-host/adjacent targets, known records, empty/sort/tend, maintenance reserves, disabled craft/cache/service and direct-command refusals remain correct. No scanner/noise bypass, remote interaction or knowledge grant.
2. World LOS handles solids, actual rib optical geometry and the supplied local heightfield without global-world leakage. Invalid inputs fail closed. Only mapped own furniture is exempt; unrelated obstruction still blocks. Physical movement/collision stays unchanged in this slice.
3. New paid Dart fabrication alone gets the clear yawπ heading. Original saved yaw/pitch/handling, other hulls, charged resources and guarded save/recovery relationships remain intact. Actual new fabrication/boarding/departure and separate legacy departure evidence are distinct.
4. Actual impact events carry positive clipped hull loss and transient centered feedback. Panels consume only validated events and focus existing records/containers/services. Cue is depth-tested/fog-aware, modest and retained/disposed without accumulation. Nonpilot eye agrees with targeting; opening/pilot camera contracts remain.
5. Deliberate pointer capture and remembered Drag/keyboard preferences remain usable through panels, Escape, denial, pause, blur/context loss, stale promise/event ordering, replacement and disposal. No automatic unwanted recapture or stale held input. Distinguish actual native lock events from synthetic relative motion.
6. Deliberate moving exit is cancellable, exactly once and immediate in the specified emergencies; simulation clearance/depth refuses authoritatively. Opening canvas hold and immediate accessible focused-button activation coexist. No movement/physics tuning or save-schema change.
7. Three corrected stocks and depleted anchors are visibly identifiable and surface-supported from useful approaches. Ordinary collect/deplete/sort/restock, food/C03/services still work. Bounded rendered terrain follows unchanged physical field, joins without cracks and preserves deck/ramp clearance. Workshop overlap is removed; twenty source target views remain usable. Inspect actual imagery/motion and measured geometry cost, not numeric exposure alone.
8. Full current checks pass; earned/older saves and actual complete-state reload are coherent. Source/build/artifact attribution, cleanup and ordinary-versus-seeded distinctions are honest. Protected provenance, schema/content, source yields/positions, recipes, hull geometry and session/writer policy have no unintended change.
9. Added UI uses concise player-facing labels without repeated decorative subtitles. Essential captions, warnings and persistence errors remain. Dependencies, performance/lifecycle risks and claimed limitations are reconciled; no unresolved blocking defect/scope violation.
